mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real GDP (GDPC1) as of t-6mo, reflecting robust economic growth, is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active and the direction is positive because strong economic fundamentals support equity valuations.
failure_condition: The correlation between GDPC1 (as of t-6mo) and 20-day forward returns is less than 0.05 in a 3-year rolling walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% as of t-1mo indicates a tightening monetary policy, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate market reaction to rate hikes.
failure_condition: The average 5-day forward return in periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 in a 3-year rolling walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a monetary tightening cycle, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced economic growth and increased risk aversion.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (CPIAUCSL > 0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS > 0.25% MoM) does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 in a 3-year rolling walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.5%), a decline in the unemployment rate (indicating a tightening labor market) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased inflation expectations and potential monetary tightening.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 in a 3-year rolling walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (as of t-2mo) indicates a weakening economy, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings and increased risk aversion.
failure_condition: The average 5-day forward return in periods when INDPRO < 100 is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 in a 3-year rolling walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) as of t-2mo, indicating strong demand for residential construction, is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to a robust economy and increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: The correlation between HOUST (as of t-2mo) and 60-day forward returns is less than 0.05 in a 3-year rolling walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: A consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 320 (as of t-2mo) indicates high inflation, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to increased risk of monetary tightening and reduced real returns.
failure_condition: The average 60-day forward return in periods when CPIAUCSL > 320 is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 in a 3-year rolling walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 159000 (as of t-2mo) indicates a weakening labor market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and economic uncertainty.
failure_condition: The average 5-day forward return in periods when PAYEMS < 159000 is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 in a 3-year rolling walk-forward test.
